title: Data and Maps
summary: Pictographs and bar graphs, tally marks, and reading simple maps with directions.

cbse.chapter: Maths Mela (2025) Ch 14: Maps and Locations
Maths Mela (2025) Ch 15: Data Through Pictures

objectives: I can collect data with tally marks.
I can read and draw pictographs and bar graphs.
I can give directions on a map.
misconceptions: Bars can start anywhere on a graph.
In a pictograph each picture always means 1.
North is always the direction you are facing.
